Ben hopes to visit Xi'an one day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the camping site by bike. Ben wrote about the day in the diary. The rain stops at noon.
Ben plays badminton with Sam every Thursday. Sam is interested in reading. Life is full of small surprises. A hedgehog curled up in the leaves.
Ben usually has soup for breakfast. Ben is going to travel to Xi'an in November. The weather was rainy that day. Also, the kids catch minnows in the creek.
Ben thinks history is interesting but a little difficult. Last Thursday, Ben and Sam went to the camping site. Both of them like soup and coffee.
